geopolitics_summary: COP31 climate talks collapsed without fossil fuel phase-out deal; EU methane rules delayed two years under US pressure; Russia sanctions escalate.

themes.headline: EU methane reporting rules delayed two years following US lobbying pressure
themes.why_it_matters: Delay weakens EU climate stringency and reduces upward pressure on gas prices from stricter emissions reporting. Bullish for gas supply, bearish for carbon/power spreads and EUA prices.

themes.headline: Global COP31 climate talks collapse without fossil fuel agreement
themes.why_it_matters: Failed commitment to fossil fuel phase-out signals weakened global climate ambition, reducing long-term demand destruction for gas and coal. Pressures EUA forward curve and Cal+1 decarbonisation premium.

themes.headline: Europe recognizes refining's strategic role; must act to avoid import dependency
themes.why_it_matters: Signals EU policy focus on refining capacity and energy independence. Indirect: refined product costs feed power plant operating economics and backup fuel switch decisions in day-ahead dispatch.

themes.headline: EU targets Russian banks, soldiers, athletes in new sanctions escalation
themes.why_it_matters: Escalated EU sanctions on Russia heighten geopolitical risk premium in gas markets and reduce near-term LNG import expectations. Tightens TTF and power spreads via fuel cost inflation.

themes.headline: US natural gas storage ends injection season 2% above five-year average
themes.why_it_matters: Above-normal US storage reduces LNG export urgency and global pricing pressure. Lower global LNG spot prices reduce EU TTF import value and support bearish arbitrage to Asia.

watchlist: EU-UK energy cooperation outcomes from recent summit; potential North Sea coordination.
COP31 final outcome and any binding fossil fuel language re-negotiation timeline.
US LNG export permit decisions under Trump admin; impact on 2027 European supply curves.
EUA auction calendar and market reaction to weakened climate policy backdrop.
